'''Oak Shakes Its Branches''' is a [[sword form]], often used by masters when training students. It deals non-lethal blows and is also very effective against large groups of opponents who are using different types of weapons. [[Gawyn Trakand]] used this form as he was challenged by [[Gareth Bryne]]'s soldiers when they would not let him enter the [[rebel Aes Sedai]] camp.{{ref/book|12|24}}
